inclusion_criteria: Works addressing LLMs, generative models, or agentic systems applied to network operations, configuration, or automation.
Papers, tool documentation, or preprints that present methods for generation, validation, repair, verification, or empirical evaluation in NetOps contexts.
Benchmarks, datasets, or evaluation frameworks explicitly intended for AIOps/NetOps or where applicability to NetOps is clearly argued.
Formal verification, runtime verification, and deterministic validators for network configurations (tools, algorithms, evaluations).
Empirical case studies, incident reports, or operator postmortems that document real-world failures attributable to automation or configuration errors.
Works from 2016–2026 with emphasis on 2020–2026 for recent LLM developments; earlier seminal tools (e.g., VeriFlow, NetPlumber, Batfish) included regardless of date.
exclusion_criteria: General NLP/LLM papers with no substantive connection to networking or operational automation.
Blog posts or marketing claims without verifiable primary data, unless they link to reproducible artifacts (code, datasets, tool repos).
Proprietary internal reports unavailable to public inspection (closed NDA content).
Papers that only benchmark language-model token-level metrics (perplexity) without task-level operational evaluation or network-focused metrics.
Works focused solely on unrelated infrastructure domains (e.g., cloud resource provisioning) unless the methods apply directly to NetOps and are justified.
date_rationale: Cover the last decade (2016–2026) to include seminal NetOps verification tools and recent LLM/AIOps advances; prioritize 2020–2026 for LLM-driven techniques and agentic workflows while retaining older foundational verification/validation work for methodological grounding.
